searchEvidence: Pull request #448 review (P2): when inspection carries a current Standard Merge exact capability, as reload and refresh inspection leases can, ResolveWithExactStandardCapability returns the direct classification before the envelope-prefix rule of CTRLRAM-OSD-ENVELOPE-CLASSIFY-1112-01 runs, so a nonstandard flash that classifies as Flash Code without an exact capability becomes Unknown in the active Standard workflow.

semanticOwner: FirmwareArtifactClassificationResolver.ResolveWithExactStandardCapability remains the only Standard classification owner; TryClassifyStandardEnvelopePrefix remains the only prefix rule.
terminalContract: When an exact Standard Merge capability is supplied and its direct classification of the candidate is Unknown, Standard classification consults the existing envelope-prefix rule (CTRLRAM-OSD-ENVELOPE-CLASSIFY-1112-01) over the current published compositions and returns its Flash Code result and prefix capability when that rule applies; otherwise the direct Unknown result is returned unchanged. A direct Flash Code or TP Firmware result, classifications without an exact capability and ICs without a Standard source envelope are unchanged. The CtrlRAM length-admission rules are unchanged, but an affected nonstandard-length Base can now classify as Standard Flash instead of Unknown and so reach that existing admission. No profile, schema, public type, CRC, output byte, name, range or expected-output change.
